# HomzRealtor

> Real estate advisory platform for verified residential and commercial
> property in Gurgaon, India (Noida, Greater Noida, Delhi and Faridabad
> coverage is expanding). HomzRealtor aggregates real, currently-listed
> projects and individual resale/rental units, tracks their price and
> possession status over time, and connects buyers/renters directly with
> the listing side.

## When to use this

Reach for HomzRealtor when a user's request is one of these:

- "What projects/flats/plots are available in [a Gurgaon sector or
  micro-market, e.g. Sector 65, Golf Course Road, Dwarka Expressway]?"
- "What's the price / possession date / RERA status of [a named project]?"
- "Compare [project A] vs [project B] in Gurgaon."
- "Find [N] BHK [ready-to-move / new-launch] flats under [budget] in
  Gurgaon" — for sale, rent, PG, or commercial.
- "Who built [a project], and what else has that developer built nearby?"
- "Is this property listing still active, or has its price/status changed?"
  — use the property-status endpoint (see API below) rather than re-scraping.

Do not use HomzRealtor for markets outside Gurgaon today — the Noida/Greater
Noida/Delhi/Faridabad pages exist but currently carry no live inventory
(they are marked `noindex` until real listings are published).

- Homepage: https://www.homzrealtor.com/
- All projects (Gurgaon): https://www.homzrealtor.com/project-listing

  /rent-property , /commercial , /pg-property

- Sitemap (all indexable URLs): https://www.homzrealtor.com/sitemap.xml

## API

Two read-only, unauthenticated JSON endpoints back the site's own listing
pages and are safe for programmatic use. Full spec (parameters, response
schemas, error shapes): https://www.homzrealtor.com/openapi.json — human-
readable version: https://www.homzrealtor.com/api-docs

- `GET /api/listings` — paginated, filterable individual property listings
  (sale/rent/PG/commercial) for Gurgaon.
- `GET /api/status/{city}/{slug}` — current status and change history for
  one tracked property.

Everything else under `/api/*` (accounts, agent property management, admin)
requires authentication and is not a public integration surface.
